scenarios.name: Navigate to client registration page
scenarios.criteria: Clicking Join Healing Sky in the main navigation and selecting Join as a Client displays the client registration page.

scenarios.name: Step-by-step partial form completion for client registration
scenarios.criteria: Filling in the Full Name, Email, Phone Number, Date of Birth, and Address Lookup fields step by step without touching Referral Code maintains the values in all fields other than Referral Code.
scenarios.endState: The form contains values for Full Name, Email, Phone Number, Date of Birth, and Address Lookup. Referral Code remains empty.

scenarios.name: Complete registration form and submit
scenarios.criteria: Entering Referral Code and completing form submission displays either a success message or redirects to the client login page.
preconditions: Client registration form fields contain valid values for all fields except Referral Code.
scenarios.startState: Client registration form is partially completed with Referral Code empty.
scenarios.endState: Registration is successful, displaying a success message or redirecting to the client login page.

scenarios.name: Navigate to client sign-in and open OTP verification screen
scenarios.criteria: Selecting Email as the OTP delivery method and entering the configured client email proceeds to the OTP verification screen.
scenarios.endState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.

scenarios.name: OTP-based client sign-in
scenarios.criteria: Entering the configured OTP bypass value authenticates the client, showing the authenticated client page or dashboard.
preconditions: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.
scenarios.startState: Client OTP verification screen is displayed.
scenarios.endState: Client is signed in and navigated to an authenticated client page like the dashboard.

scenarios.name: Log out from authenticated client dashboard
scenarios.criteria: Using the profile menu to log out successfully returns to the Healing Sky homepage showing the Log in or Sign In option.
preconditions: User is signed into the client dashboard.
scenarios.endState: Healing Sky homepage is loaded with Log in or Sign In option visible.
